entityDescription:
Multifaceted and practice-oriented
 
- around 18,000 students
- 85 Bachelor's and Master’s degree programmes 
- 500 professors
- 675 staff members and researchers
- 750 part-time lecturers
- 14 departments 
HM Hochschule München University of Applied Sciences is the second largest university of applied sciences in Germany. Our 18,000 students and our location in a leading European business centre afford fantastic opportunities, but also mean we have a responsibility in industrial, economic and social contexts. 
Multidisciplinary variety
We offer degree courses and active academic collaboration in the MINT subjects (mathematics, computer science, natural sciences and engineering), business, the social sciences and public health as well as in architecture and design. Our Department of General and Interdisciplinary Studies is unique in providing every student with a cross-disciplinary education and in developing their personal skills. 
Studying with a profile
It is especially important for us to nurture our graduates' characters: besides their well-founded professional skills, our students should stand out by thinking and acting in a sustainable, entrepreneurial and intercultural way. With these additional qualifications which reach beyond the students' specialist fields, we prepare them to contribute to society and to approach their careers with foresight, creativity and a sense of responsibility. 
From Bachelor's degree to doctoral qualification
We offer and develop individualised study approaches and options for applicants with varied educational backgrounds, thus opening our university and offering a range of paths for lifelong learning and studying. 
Hochschule München ensures excellent applied and research-based teaching in four areas: 
 
- Bachelor's degrees for school leavers and the professionally qualified
- Master's degrees and doctoral qualifications
- Continuing education and life-long learning in all fields
- Applied research 
Growth with a view to the future
Hochschule München actively engages with its educational mandate and aims to secure an outstanding position as a university of applied sciences. It recognises the future demands of society and industry and is changing, with a critical yet open vision for current issues, such as the current digitalisation of all areas of life. It focuses on continually improving quality and on constant development in research, teaching and continuing education.

entityDescription:
TAS-L leverages big data, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity to address complex end-to-end challenges, while fostering excellence in user experience. Its expertise covers innovative design and implementation approaches with customers, minimum viable products development, design and development of key digital building blocks of space systems, rollout and operations of solutions, experimentation of new technologies and concepts, digital business models, and international project management.
The company has currently 28 employees (21 FTE, 7 consultants), growing, and its operational site is located at the Technoport, a start-up incubator in Belval, Luxembourg. TAS-L will move to its permanent office in the third quarter of 2024. Its development environment is cloud native and based on the Thales Digital Platform, a state of the art digital environment operated by Thales and supporting a set of security levels. 
TAS-L’s current portfolio of products and projects encompasses:
· a Secured Digital Platform supporting TAS Earth Observation applications
· Key Digital Components of Space Inspire Ground Segment
· a 3-Dimension visualizer “Orthoglobe” for professionals of the space industry 
· A Proof-of- Concept Digital Twin system. TAS-L acting as Prime Contractor 
· An Artificial Intelligence Data Processing Platform hosting 2 MVPs targeted respectively at Land-Use and Biodiversity impact assessment, and, Greenhouse Gas and Air Quality impact assessment.
These projects and products are developed for either external customers (institutional, private, defence), or TAS Business Lines (Telecom and Earth-Observation).

TAS-Luxembourg is also a Local anchor for business development in and through Luxembourg and an Active member of the local and Regional Eco-System

description: Freedom and individual responsibility, entrepreneurial spirit and open-mindedness: ETH Zurich stands on a bedrock of true Swiss values. Our university for science and technology dates back to the year 1855, when the founders of modern-day Switzerland created it as a centre of innovation and knowledge. At ETH Zurich, students discover an ideal environment for independent thinking, researchers a climate which inspires top performance. Situated in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, ETH Zurich is pioneering effective solutions to the global challenges of today and tomorrow.
entityDescription:
ETH Zurich is one of the leading international universities for technology and the natural sciences.
It is well-known for its excellent education, ground-breaking fundamental research and for putting its new findings directly into practice. It offers researchers an inspiring working environment and its students a comprehensive education.
Founded in 1855, ETH Zurich today has some 18,000 students from over 100 different countries, 3,800 of whom are doctoral students. About 500 professors currently teach and conduct research in the areas of engineering, architecture, mathematics, natural sciences, system-oriented sciences, and management and social sciences.
ETH Zurich regularly appears at the top of international rankings as one of the best universities in the world. 21 Nobel Laureates have studied, taught or conducted research at ETH Zurich, underlining the excellent reputation of the institute.
Transferring its knowledge to the private sector and society at large is one of ETH Zurich¿s primary concerns. It does this very successfully, as borne out by the 80 new patent applications each year and some 260 spin-off companies that emerged from the institute between 1996 and 2012.
ETH Zurich helps to find long-term solutions to global challenges. The focal points of its research include energy supply, risk management, developing the cities of the future, global food security and human health.

entityDescription:
Fraunhofer IZFP is an internationally networked research and development institute in the field of applied research. Its activities are focused on the development of "cognitive sensor systems" for the nondestructive monitoring of industrial processes and value chains. The Institute's technical understanding of inspection and sensor physics is supplemented by technologies and concepts from AI research, which are used to develop sensor systems for the NDT of tomorrow. In addition to pure production processes, the activities cover equally processes from materials and product development, maintenance, repair, and recycling of materials.
With better security, reliability and lower costs in mind, the focus of the institute‘s application-oriented, industrial-purpose innovations is improving the quality of the customer‘s products.
Fraunhofer IZFP offers its customers and research partners the entire range of nondestructive testing technologies. The institute‘s researchers, engineers and technicians develop solutions to address modern testing applications including feasibility studies, consulting, training and inspection services and creating prototype systems.
The development results of the institute are systematically interlinked with modern information and communication technologies. Machine learning concepts are used for intelligent signal and image processing or for the automated interpretation and assessment of test and measurement data.

entityDescription:
Livelink Aerospace has been working in passive detection for several years, developing sensors and systems that offer high resilience and excellent cost/ benefit compared to traditional sensor types.Recently winning a tender put forth by DASA (Defence and Security Accelerator), on behalf of the DSTL (Defence Science and Technology Laboratory), we are rapidly prototyping and developing novel technologies that increase detection at low altitude of non-cooperative aircraft (manned and unmanned), whilst driving the cost far below that of conventional methods such as radar.Part of our remit is also to be (where possible), passive in our approach to detection; this gives us great advantages such as zero licensing issues and non-interference with infrastructure near our sensor nodes.

As an SME we have developed passive electronics to accurately locate sources of RF since 2016. The foundational technology has successfully achieved several km of real-world detection from low power sources (which were transmitting at sub one Watt of power in the 2.4GHz and 5.8GHz ranges).

The trajectory of our core technology has been significantly helped by the Defence and Security Accelerator (DASA) which funded an application in 2020 to develop our core technology with the addition of an advanced sensor fusion layer added to it. This has allowed us to significantly increase the number, and complexity of sensors feeding into the LiveLink system. It also allows us to successfully fuse data from a wide range of other sensors such as acoustic, optical, RF and Radar. EC Technik GmbH, a German based private owned company is today one of the global leading manufacturers of lightweight composites products. Since its foundation in 2010 EC Technik GmbH has
acquired a high level of experience in composites mainly for aerospace business.
The product range consists of various types of honeycomb, panels, formed and/or machined parts as well as ready-to-install parts for high-tech composite solutions. Our continuous broadening of the product range and investment in production facilities, high-tech equipment as well as human resources, makes us today a competitive business partner with more than 30 employees.
Being AS9001 and EASA 21 qualified, as well as by Airbus, Boeing and other spacecraft and aircraft manufacturers worldwide, we can look back to a broad experience in EC Technik GmbH composites. EC Technik GmbH has the expertise and the relevant infrastructure to realize the space projects. The tasks, which have to be performed in this potential project, will be realized with a dedicated Space-Engineering
team.
The main business units at EC Technik GmbH are divided in the areas Aviation, Space, Defence, Industry Rail Technology and Industry Mechanical Engineering. This broad diversification of industry sections and heritage, gives EC Technik GmbH high-efficient interface solutions.
Additional investments into sophisticated Space equipment, lead to a unique selling proposition for Space parts in Europe. With high-level equipment for Space-parts manufacturing, has the opportunity to
offer an excellent environment for their demand in high-valued Space components. Furthermore, EC Technik GmbH have the opportunity to support the customers in an early stage of design and engineering with a broad knowledge in FEM-Simulations (Pre-processing,
Solving, Post-Processing) for composites and metal parts. With its own Center of Excellence
which comprises over 50 engineers, chemists and technicians, EC Technik GmbH supports
customers in technical developments.
The long-term experience in the Space Business with high quality parts and flight heritage of
our parts, rates EC Technik GmbH as a reliable partner. Short delivery times, competitive pricing
and excellent quality are an integral part of our company policy.

entityDescription:
Incremental is an award-winning software engineering consultancy based in York. Our dynamic and trustworthy team develops and delivers innovative data-driven software solutions and location tracking systems to the rail industry. 
 
Our range of products helps reduce disruption and delays on the rail network through an efficient and accurate flow of information. Our pioneering GPS data provides unique insights and comprehensive reporting functions that enable train operators and infrastructure providers to manage, monitor and continuously improve their performance.
 
Our ground-breaking technology provides large scale monitoring of train movements, and our aggregation, storage and processing of billions of data points, makes sense of ‘Big Data’ problems. 
 
Fully measurable maps visualise stations, junctions, passing points and signals to unlock and expose a range of performance issues faced on the railway. The rapid analysis capability our software solutions offer allows for immediate awareness of speed restrictions, delay location identification and planning and timetable verification – key information to improve performance across the rail network.
 
Our products give our clients greater control of situations as they happen with easily accessible, accurate and credible data to improve communication between all parties involved, helping UK rail passengers enjoy a more reliable, safe and comfortable journey experience. Using advanced machine learning, remote condition monitoring, data aggregation and trending techniques, we provide insights into vehicle performance that have historically been unachievable.
 
Our range of solutions provide information across mobile, web and desktop enterprise applications and are designed to offer straight-forward, accessible information to our customers.
 
Through our collaborative approach with our clients, such as Network Rail, Northern and Great Western Railway, we jointly identify problems and deliver technology driven applications to alleviate those problems. Our incredibly experienced team delivers solutions that make the railway, greener, safer and more reliable for everyone.
 
We’ve won several awards in recognition of our innovative, industry changing products. We genuinely believe the railway can perform better and we’re passionate about developing the technology that drives that positive change.
